# @fyit/crouton-flow components

## CroutonFlow

Interactive node graph with DAG auto-layout, drag/drop, minimap, and optional real-time sync

File: `app/components/Flow.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `Record<string, unknown>[] \| Node<any, any, string>[]` | - | no | Collection rows to display as nodes (not needed when sync=true). In ephemeral mode (data-mode="ephemeral") these are pre-built Vue Flow Node[] rather than raw collection rows — hence the union. The component consumes them as records internally (see the cast at the ephemeral branch). Widened so consumers can v-model:rows a typed Node[] ref without TS2322 (#233). |
| `collection` | `string` | - | yes | Collection name for component resolution and mutations |
| `parentField` | `string` | `"parentId"` | no | Field containing parent ID (default: 'parentId') |
| `positionField` | `string` | `"position"` | no | Field containing position { x, y } (default: 'position') |
| `labelField` | `string` | `"title"` | no | Field to use as label (default: 'title') |
| `flowConfig` | `FlowConfig` | - | no | Flow configuration |
| `controls` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Whether to show controls (default: true) |
| `minimap` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Whether to show minimap (default: false) |
| `background` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Whether to show background (default: true) |
| `backgroundPattern` | `"dots" \| "lines"` | `"dots"` | no | Background pattern (default: 'dots') |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Whether nodes are draggable (default: true) |
| `fitViewOnMount` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Whether to fit view on mount (default: true) |
| `sync` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Enable real-time sync mode |
| `flowId` | `string` | - | no | Flow ID for sync mode (required if sync=true) |
| `allowDrop` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Allow items to be dropped onto the flow (default: false) |
| `allowedCollections` | `string[]` | `[]` | no | Collections allowed to be dropped (empty = all allowed) |
| `autoCreateOnDrop` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Whether to auto-create nodes when items are dropped (default: true in sync mode) |
| `nodeTypeComponents` | `Record<string, NodeTypeRegistration>` | - | no | Custom node type components (key = node type string, value = component + isContainer flag) |
| `containerOptions` | `FlowContainerOptions` | - | no | Container detection options — enable card-over-group overlap detection on drag stop |
| `dataMode` | `FlowDataMode` | `"collection"` | no | Data mode: 'collection' (default) or 'ephemeral' (skip collection mutations) |
| `savedPositions` | `Record<string, { x: number; y: number; }> \| null` | - | no | Pre-loaded node positions from flow_configs (avoids extra fetch) |
| `selected` | `string[]` | - | no | Selected node IDs (enables v-model:selected) |
| `additionalEdges` | `{ id: string; source: string; target: string; }[]` | - | no | Additional edges to render alongside parent-derived edges |
| `backgroundPatternColor` | `string` | - | no | Color for background dot/line pattern (default: '#aaa') |
| `defaultNodeComponent` | `Component` | - | no | Explicit component for the default node render path. When set it overrides the by-collection-name resolution (`{Collection}Node`) — the only way a wrapper in this prefixed package (e.g. CroutonFlowSiteFlow's page card) can inject its own node card, since the `CroutonFlow` component prefix makes the by-name lookup unreachable. Ghost nodes still render as ghosts. |
| `focusBounds` | `{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; } \| null` | - | no | Camera focus: a rectangle (flow coords) to frame — set it to zoom the canvas onto that area (e.g. a node the host is rendering at a specific size), clear it (null/undefined) to fit the whole board. Deterministic (fitBounds) — pass the rect the focused node WILL occupy and the camera frames it without waiting for Vue Flow to re-measure. View transform only. |

## CroutonFlowSiteFlow

Site level of the Crouton Builder: a canvas of page cards wired into a sitemap

File: `app/components/SiteFlow.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | `Record<string, unknown>[]` | - | yes | Page rows — the same rows the pages collection / tree view uses. |
| `collection` | `string` | `"pages"` | no | Collection name (drives edge persistence via the parent field). |
| `parentField` | `string` | `"parentId"` | no | Field holding the parent page id — the wiring. |
| `labelField` | `string` | `"label"` | no | Field to label the card with. |
| `flowId` | `string` | - | no | flow_configs id — set it to persist card positions (and required for sync). |
| `sync` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Enable real-time multiplayer (Yjs). |
| `savedPositions` | `Record<string, { x: number; y: number; }> \| null` | `null` | no | Pre-loaded positions from flow_configs (avoids an extra fetch). |
| `minimap` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Show the minimap (handy for large sitemaps). |

| Event | Payload |
| --- | --- |
| `zoomIntoPage` | `[page: Record<string, unknown>]` |
| `pageClick` | `[pageId: string, page: Record<string, unknown>]` |
